profile.headline: Software Engineer at PVcase
profile.summary: BS in Biomedical Engineering with a minor in Computer Science focused on Artificial Intelligence. Highly capable in problem solving, designing and prototyping with an emphasis on the health care industry. Interested in development of health care products ranging from Apps to devices. Devoted to increasing diversity in the STEM fields by utilizing leadership and communication skills.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Embedded & Backend)
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description:
·	Tutored students, in person and as an online platform) ranging from elementary school level up to adults interested in learning new subjects
·	Instructed students in subjects such as Mathematics, Science, Computer Science, English and French 
·	Had to adjust to the learning styles of each individual student and also learn how to explain subjects at a level the student could understand

positions.title: Innovation Think Tank Intern
positions.description:
· Coordinated and organized project groups comprised of multiple nationalities across different time zones
· Honed technical presentation and public speaking communication skills by consistently interacting with non-native English speakers
· Implemented project solutions through rapid physical prototypes and/or software ranging from healthcare apps to medical robotics
· Performed market analysis and customer feedback surveys in U.S.A, Germany and Turkey

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
·	Designed products to be used in spinal surgery including tools and implants for lateral approach minimally invasive surgery, deformity surgery and oblique lateral interbody fusion surgery
·	Created engineering drawings to manufacturing standards
·	Performed tolerance stacks on assemblies
·	Ran SolidWorks FEA to test part or assembly integrity
·	Formatted excel spreadsheets using Visual BASIC
·	Communicated with outside vendors to order parts or supplies
·	Wrote FDA verification and validation reports

positions.title: Teaching Assistant in BMED 2300
positions.description:
·	Led a two-hour design lab twice per week
·	Responsible for grading projects for 20-30 students and overseeing 3 other teaching assistants
·	Assisted students with drafting/technical drawing techniques, engineering analysis of a medical device, 3D modeling and prototyping skills
·	Guided students in their design improvement process for a medical device of their choosing

positions.title: Research Assistant at the Dr. Guldberg lab
positions.description:
•	Tested different methods of cell delivery to optimize bone growth
•	Trained in histology techniques such as embedding, sectioning and staining
•	Participated in animal surgeries, acting as a surgeon’s assistant

projects.title: Prosthetic Leg Design
projects.description:
Goal of Project: Create an innovative design of a prosthetic using Autodesk Fusion 360
Solution: Designed a prosthetic leg that was cost effective and aesthetically pleasing.

projects.title: Forge Healthcare Hackathon Presentation
projects.description: Pitch given at the Forge Healthcare Hackathon. The product, Kounter, is a device that allows surgeons to keep an accurate count of materials and utensils during procedures to improve efficiency and safety.
